name: Morbegno (Italy)
description: Red field charged at the centre with two white keys in saltire and a white sword with a yellow hilt in pale (the arms of Morbegno).
history: Municipal flag of Morbegno, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: two keys in saltire with a sword in pale between them
